publications.title: Demands for disguised remuneration scheme loan repayments
publications.summary: We have seen demands being made for people to repay loans, or purported loans, provided as part of disguised remuneration schemes. Disguised remuneration schemes saw people – often contractors, consultants and agency workers – paid for their work through loans instead of regular salaries as a way to avoid tax. HMRC has sought to tackle this tax avoidance through what has been termed the loan charge and published guidance for those affected.Questions have been raised about the regulatory status of these loans and whether they were ever intended to be repaid.Some of those affected dispute liability for the amounts being claimed and challenge whether the debts can be legally enforced. publications.title: FCA publishes terms of reference for independent review concerning Mr Andriesz
publications.summary: We have published the terms of reference for the review into our handling of interactions with Mr Simon Andriesz, a whistleblower who made protected disclosures to the FCA. We shared our condolences following Mr Andriesz's tragic death and our thoughts remain with his family and loved ones.The review was commissioned by our non-executive directors. It is being conducted by Lea Paterson CBE, an independent non-executive director of the FCA.When we announced the review, we said it would examine how we interacted with Mr Andriesz. The review will now also look at whether we met our responsibilities under whistleblowing law and followed our own policies and procedures when handling his whistleblowing reports, including his concerns that he had experienced detriment.
